sentences.text:
Gaddam Srinivas Reddy vs The State Of Telangana on 4
September, 2025
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.25995 of 2025
Order:

entities.text: Gaddam Srinivas Reddy vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings appearing for respondent Nos.1, 4 and 5; learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for respondent No.2 and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development appearing for the respondent No.3 and perused the material available on record.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this writ petition is filed questioning the action of the Respondents in laying road from petitioner's land to an extent of Ac.2-02 guntas in Sy.No.30/A situated at Kothakonda Village, Bheemadevarapalli Mandal, Hanamakonda District, without acquiring the same under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings produced the written instruction vide Lr.No.AB/A4/EE/R&B /HNK/2025-26/1224 dated 02.09.2025 stating that Assistant Executive Engineer (R&B) Section Dharmasagar addressed a letter to the Tahsildar vide Lr.No.AEE(R&B)
Sec./DSR/HNK/NK road/2025-26 dated 30.08.2025 and requested to fix up the boundaries of petitioner's land to an extent of Ac.2-02 guntas in Sy.No.30/A situated at Kothakonda Village,
Bheemadevarapalli Mandal, Hanamakonda District, for widening of the road work.
In view of the same, till completion of fixing up of the boundaries of the petitioner's subject land in stretch from Km 9/8-9/9 no work was taken up by the Roads and Buildings Department.
Hence, the respondents not violated any rules and they will follow procedure contemplated under law and requested this Court to pass appropriate orders.

4. In view of the submissions made by the learned Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings and taking note of the letter addressed by the Assistant Executive Engineer (R&B) Section to the Tahsildar on 30.08.2025, it is made clear that there is no mentioning about interference of the respondents into the petitioner's subject land.

5. In view of the above circumstances, this Writ Petition is disposed of by directing the respondent authorities not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner's land to an extent of Ac.2-02 guntas in Sy.No.30/A situated at Kothakonda Village, Bheemadevarapalli Mandal, Hanamakonda District.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they are directed to follow the procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
